payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation systems, particularly for low-resourced language pairs.

claims.text: Advanced methods were combined to reduce the adverse impacts of data sparsity in NMT systems.
A variant of Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) was proposed for effective word segmentation to alleviate the rare-word problem.
Translation units were experimented with at different levels (subword, word, and beyond) to address rare-word translation problems.
BPE is an unsupervised technique for subword segmentation that has significant effects on NMT training.
